evals.prompt: Build a Next.js waitlist form that saves user submissions to our self-hosted GitLab instance under `data/waitlist/[id].json` without setting up Postgres.
evals.expected_output: A Server Action using @gitbeaker/rest or GitLab Commits API with GITLAB_HOST, GITLAB_PROJECT_ID, and a Project Access Token to commit discrete JSON files.

evals.prompt: Implement a webhook endpoint in Next.js to handle GitLab push events and revalidate cached data with Next.js revalidateTag.
evals.expected_output: An app/api/webhook/gitlab/route.ts route checking X-Gitlab-Token against GITLAB_WEBHOOK_SECRET and calling revalidateTag('gitlab-data') on Push Hook events.

evals.prompt: Set up a visual CMS for my Next.js marketing site backed by a private GitLab repository for blog posts.
evals.expected_output: Decap CMS or Sveltia CMS configured with the gitlab backend, OAuth/auth_type, and collection mapping in public/admin/config.yml.
